run_test_command: run the TestCommand to test dataset loading with a specified cache directory and data directory
test_all_configs: test all dataset configurations by running TestCommand with the all_configs flag enabled
test_with_force_redownload: run the TestCommand with force_redownload to re-download the dataset from scratch
test_with_save_infos: run the TestCommand with save_infos to generate a dataset card README.md file
test_with_clear_cache: run the TestCommand with clear_cache to remove cached files after each configuration test
